implicit_mechanism.trt_log: Calibrator is not being used. Users must provide dynamic range for all tensors that are not Int32 or Bool.
implicit_mechanism.meaning: --int8 without a calibration cache -> TRT has no data-derived activation ranges. It still runs INT8 kernels (the implicit engine is FASTER than FP16, 9.43<13.28 ms, and SMALLER, 58.76<81.43 MiB — so INT8 kernels ARE active; it is NOT a pure FP16 fallback), but on UNCONTROLLED (non-data-derived) ranges. Therefore its accuracy is NOT claimed: here it happens to land near FP16 (0.4073, −3.9%), but the companion ResNet50-DLA implicit collapsed to 0.017 on the same uncontrolled path. Only an explicit, calibrated QDQ engine gives an accuracy you can stand behind.

divergence_note: global Pearson corr over all 100x92 logits is dominated by the no-object logit dimension, so it is nearly identical for sym (0.982) and implicit (0.980) despite a 0.17 mAP gap — a weak proxy. pycocotools mAP is the authoritative metric.
